artworks.title: St. Bonaventura; St. Justus; St. Henry, Emperor; St. Antiochus
artworks.description: There are four illustrations in oval frames within a grid of empty rectangles. The top left shows Saint Bonaventure kneeling, facing an angel holding a chalice, set against columns and drapery. The top right depicts Saint Justus, a soldier holding a musical instrument with another figure next to him in Roman-style armor under a cloudy sky. The bottom left features Saint Henry, a king with demons nearby holding a church-like building, with a simple structure in the background. The bottom right shows Antiochus reclining with attendants in a landscape setting with clouds. Each frame is labeled with the saint's name and the date, 14th or 15th of July, with "Israel ex" at the bottom of each oval.

artworks.title: St. Mary of Mont Carmel; St. Raineldis; St. Alexis; St. Arnold of Metz
artworks.description: The image features four circular illustrations, each depicting different religious or historical scenes. The top left roundel shows a figure on a cloud surrounded by smaller figures and labeled "S. MARIA DE MONTE CARMEL." The top right roundel shows two figures in action with a third figure on the ground, labeled "S RAINELDVS." The bottom left roundel depicts a group of figures around a standing individual, labeled "S. ALEXIS." The bottom right roundel shows a figure kneeling in prayer amid rocky or indoor surroundings, labeled "S. ARNVLPHVS ABB. M." Each roundel is labeled with the month "IVL" corresponding to July.

artworks.title: St. Frederick; St. Arsenius, Hermit; St. Elias, Prophet; St. Joseph the Just
artworks.description:
This image depicts four scenes in oval frames. 

Full description: 
- Top left frame: a bearded figure between two others near a stone structure. 
- Top right frame: a figure praying in a cave with a ship in the background. 
- Bottom left frame: a figure reclining on the ground gazing at a chariot in the clouds. 
- Bottom right frame: a figure with a halo holding a cup, with two attendants and a city in the distance. Each scene is detailed with fine lines and marked "Julij."

artworks.title: St. Margaret of Antioch; St. Praxedes; St. Mary Magdalene; St. Bridget of Sweden
artworks.description: The image contains four separate drawings, each within an oval frame labeled with a name and date. The drawings depict female religious figures: St. Margaret holding a cross and book with a dragon below her; St. Praxedes kneeling and attending to a pot; St. Mary Magdalen praying before a rocky formation; and St. Bridget kneeling in prayer.

artworks.title: St. Christina; St. James, Apostle, and St. Christopher; St. Anne; Seven Sleepers of Ephesus
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four distinct oval scenes. The top left oval shows an archer drawing his bow towards a female figure tied to a tree, with a dramatic sky and other figures in the background. The top right oval features two standing figures, one with a halo and staff, and the other holding a child. The bottom left oval shows a seated figure holding a child by a large piece of architectural structure. The bottom right oval depicts a group of sleeping figures next to a rocky cliff, with some figures standing in the distance. Each scene is labeled with relevant text and numbers below.

artworks.title: St. Pantaleon; Sts. Nazarius and Celsus; St. Martha; St. Beatrice
artworks.description: This image showcases four different scenes with date annotations from July 27th to 29th. The top left features a figure on a rock with another person in the background noted as "Spantaleo n. Medic." on July 27. The top right depicts two figures under a dramatic sky labeled "SS. Nazarius M. et Celsvs." on July 28. The bottom left shows a gathering of people at a doorway titled "S. Marta Virg." on July 29. The bottom right portrays a scene by a building titled "S. Beatrix Mart." also on July 29. Each scene is intricately detailed with architectural and natural elements and may depict saintly or historical narratives.

artworks.title: Sts. Donatilla, Maxima & Secunda; St. Fabius; St. John Colombini; St. Ignatius Loyola
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four religious scenes depicted within oval frames, each labeled with the date "Juli" and numbers. The top left frame shows individuals near a grid-like structure; the top right frame features an individual holding a banner; the lower left frame portrays a figure in prayer before an altar; and the lower right frame shows an individual holding a palm branch within an architectural backdrop. The drawing is characterized by fine lines and detailed shading.

artworks.title: St. Peter,  Apostle; St. Mary of Angels; Discovery of the Body of St. Stephen; St. Dominicus
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four religious-themed scenes depicted within circular frames. The upper left scene shows an angel freeing a man from chains in a sparse, barred room. The upper right depicts a celestial figure seated on a throne with attendants, encompassed by clouds and radiant light. The lower left features an interior with someone recovering in a curtained four-poster bed while a visitor stands nearby. The lower right illustrates a scene of a cloaked figure with a staff outside, standing beside a dog, with an architectural backdrop and other figures around. The drawing is detailed with inscriptions at the bottom of each scene.

artworks.title: St. Mary of Snow; St. Memmius, Bishop; The Transfiguration; Sts. Justus and Pastor
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring four religious scenes within oval frames. The top left frame shows an image labeled "S. Maria Ad Nives." The top right frame is labeled "SMENNIVS EPIS." The bottom left frame is labeled "TRANSFIGURATIO DNI NRI." The bottom right frame is titled "SS. IVSTVS ET PASTOR." Each frame is accompanied by a signature that reads "Israel exc." and a date represented by Roman numerals "AVG."

artworks.title: St. Albert of Sicliy, Carmelite; St. Martinus;St. Demetrius and Companions; St. Lawrence
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four separate circular vignettes, each depicting different scenes. The first vignette shows two figures in conversation or debate, with a landscape element in the background. The second vignette shows a creature attacking a figure while onlookers observe from above. The third vignette shows multiple figures, some carrying weapons or tools. The fourth vignette shows an individual lying on a surface while another figure holds an elongated object, observed by a crowd.

artworks.title: St. Alexander Carbonarius; St. Clare; St. Digna and Companions; St. Concordia
artworks.description: The image consists of four oval illustrations, each depicting different religious figures or scenes. The top left illustration shows a figure holding a pastoral staff interacting with another robed figure carrying a burden on their back. The top-center image shows a robed and hooded figure standing serenely holding a book, with figures in the background engaged in a procession. The bottom left illustration depicts people engaged in prayer or reverence near a large wooden box. The bottom right illustration shows a figure raising a whip or flail while another figure leans over, with ruins or structures in the backdrop. Each scene is framed with text indicating religious dedications or calendar dates.

artworks.title: St. Hippolytus; St. Radegund, Queen; St. Cassian; St. Athanasia
artworks.description: The image is divided into four oval sections, featuring full-body illustrations of individuals. In the top left section, Saint Hippolytus stands holding a palm leaf, wearing a long robe. The background shows buildings and people with spears. The top right section features Saint Radegund in a gown, a cape, and a crown, against a background of architectural structures and small figures. In the bottom left section, Saint Cassian stands with a halo and a cloth draped over his torso, surrounded by smaller figures with canes. The bottom right section features a seated female figure marked 'Sathanais' looking upwards with beams of light shining on her from the sky. She is seated at a loom with small rural buildings in the background. Each frame has an inscription at the top and a blank space underneath.

artworks.title: The Assumption; St. Roch; Salvator Mundi; St. Clare of Monte Falco
artworks.description: The image contains four oval illustrations of figures in religious contexts. The top left shows a female figure ascending amidst clouds with onlookers below. The top right panel depicts a male figure standing with a staff, accompanied by a dog and a child. The lower left features a central male figure engaging with a group of individuals. The lower right shows a woman standing in a frontal position, holding a large crozier. The backgrounds vary, depicting landscapes with structures and distant hills. Each panel is framed with lines and labeled with words and dates in Latin.

artworks.title: St. Helen; St. Donatus; St. Ludovicus, Bishop; St. Bernard
artworks.description: The drawing consists of a 2x2 grid showing religious scenes. In the top left, a figure with a halo is kneeling outdoors with buildings in the background and rays from above. The scene is connected to St. Helena. In the top right, a figure is in a cave, with a person and a beast in the distance, possibly Saint Donatus. The lower left shows a figure in religious vestments blessing or addressing a kneeling figure, representing St. Ludovicus. In the bottom right, another figure is seated outside, engaged in reading or writing, representing St. Bernard. The drawing is detailed, capturing the spiritual scenes and surrounding architecture.

artworks.title: St. Philibert, Abbot; St. Privatus; St. Symphorian; St. Philip
artworks.description: This drawing depicts four religious scenes. In the top left, a figure with a halo extends a hand toward a body of water with ships; in the top right, two armored figures are attacking a figure; in the bottom left, a group of figures led by one with a halo is walking; and in the bottom right, a figure with a halo stands holding a cross in front of a town. Each scene is enclosed in an oval with titles and dates labeled at the bottom. The dates are in August.

artworks.title: St. Aurea; St. Bartholomew; St. Louis; St. Genesius
artworks.description: The image is divided into four panels depicting different historical and religious scenes. In the top left panel, labeled "S. AVREA VIRG.," three figures in robes stand by a body of water. One figure appears to be baptizing another, while a third figure holds a staff. Buildings line the shoreline in the background. The top right panel, labeled "S. BARTHOLOMEVS APLUS," shows a figure tied to an X-shaped cross with two other figures in loincloths nearby. Ruins and open skies are in the background. In the bottom left panel, titled "S. LVDOVICVS REX FRANCIAE," a figure in regal attire stands in front of an architectural backdrop, holding a scepter. The bottom right panel, "S. GENNEYS MART.," features three figures; a kneeling person is tended to by a robed figure and angels, with architectural structures and onlookers in the background. The panels have an ornate, historical illustrative style.

artworks.title: St. Patricia; Sts. Secundus and Alexander; St. Cesarius; St. Augustine
artworks.description: The image is divided into four oval panels, each featuring different people. In the panel marked "25 Aug," a figure faces left wearing a wide-brimmed hat and long robe, carrying a staff, with other similarly dressed figures in the background and the dome of a building visible. The panel labeled "26 Aug" shows a group of people in various poses; one figure in profile, wearing a halo, is escorted by others towards a structure, with another person gesturing towards the group. The "27 Aug" section presents a figure in profile facing left, also in a wide-brimmed hat and robe, reaching out towards a group of figures standing in front of a large architectural element like a column. The "28 Aug" panel features a bearded man with a halo standing and holding a book, wearing a robe, with another person kneeling at his feet and ancient-looking buildings in the background. Each scene contains specific elements such as hats and halos, suggesting figures of significance, set against background elements like buildings and columns.

artworks.title: St. Mederic, Abbot; Beheading of John the Baptist; St. Fiacre; Festival of the Belt of the Virgin
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four separate ovals depicting different scenes. In the top left oval, figures are gathered around a seated figure in saintly robes in an ancient village. The top right oval shows a figure in distress or defeat, with additional figures in a lavish interior setting. The bottom left oval portrays a figure standing majestically with others kneeling before them. The bottom right oval depicts a robed figure engaged in an activity in a natural landscape, with a walled town in the background. The composition, style, and line work suggest a focus on religious narratives or historical representations.

artworks.title: St. Giles; St. Lupus; St. Anne; St. Nonnosus
artworks.description: This drawing features four distinct oval illustrations depicting various scenes with religious figures. The top-left scene shows a figure sitting under trees with a deer nearby. The top-right illustration depicts a figure standing at an altar with others behind them. The bottom-left image shows a figure standing with an outstretched arm pointing towards an architectural structure, accompanied by several others. The bottom-right scene shows a figure kneeling and gesturing towards a cloud formation. The drawings are labeled with different names and titles, indicating a religious or saintly context.

artworks.title: St. Mansuetus; Sts. Serapia and Erasma; Moses; St. Bertin, Abbot
artworks.description: The image shows four oval illustrations of biblical or saintly figures with labels of their names and feast days in September. The top left illustration features Saint Mansuetus, a bishop in profile holding a crozier. The top right shows Saint Seraphia and Saint Erasma with an angel. The bottom left depicts Moses holding the tablets of the Ten Commandments. The bottom right shows Saint Bertin gesturing towards a boat on a shore. Each figure is in minimalistic settings.

artworks.title: St. Eleutherius, Abbot; St. Regina; St. John; The Nativity of the Virgin
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four oval scenes. The first scene shows a religious figure in long robes outside a small church. The second scene depicts a figure standing in a tub of water with others around and a dove flying above. The third scene shows a figure addressing a crowd on a city street. The fourth scene shows a woman in bed with figures attending to an infant. Each scene is labeled with religious or saintly names, marked "SEPT." and numerals. The drawing's style suggests intricate line work similar to engravings.

artworks.title: Sts. Gorgonius & Dorothy; St. Nicholas of Tolentino; St. Polianus & Nemesian; St. Pulcheria
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four circular vignette illustrations arranged in a grid, each depicting different scenes. The top left scene shows a stylized whipping, the top right shows a praying figure alongside architectural details, the bottom left depicts figures engaged in a confrontation, while the bottom right features a robed figure holding staffs. Each vignette is distinctly labeled with dates in September and Latin annotations. The lines are minimal and fine.

artworks.title: St. Paphnutius; Sts. Macedonius and Theodulus; St. Amatus; St. Cornelias
artworks.description: Four circular illustrations featuring biblical or religious themes are described. Each illustration is contained within its own circular frame and labeled with saints or religious figures alongside specific days in September. The top left illustration shows a figure with a mitre by a hut grasping a long wooden plank. The top right illustration depicts a figure lying on a bed-like structure surrounded by others, one holding a staff, with ancient architecture in the background. The bottom left illustration shows a figure standing among rock formations holding an object. The bottom right scene portrays a moment of execution or martyrdom, with one figure raising a sword over another amidst urban ruins. The scenes are outlined in a traditional etching style.

artworks.title: Exaltation of the Holy Cross; St. Aper; St. Euphemia; St. Lambert
artworks.description: This drawing features four oval-shaped vignettes, each representing a date in September with different religious scenes. The top left vignette depicts figures in an ancient setting, with one carrying a large cross. The top right shows a figure in robes addressing three seated figures, framed by religious architecture. The bottom left shows an angel appearing to a kneeling person in a dramatic landscape. The bottom right depicts a religious figure pointing upwards, surrounded by other figures. The drawing is detailed with precise line work and shading, creating depth in each scene.
